definitions.gloss: gesture; body language; physical movement to convey meaning
definitions.explanation: Movements of the body, especially the hands and arms, used to express or emphasize something. Often paired with 手振り in the set phrase 身振り手振り.

examples.japanese: {身振|みぶ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{伝|つた}えた→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
{身振|みぶ}り⟦{手振|てぶ}り→手振り：26261_teburi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|まじ}えて⟦{説明|せつめい}した→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: I explained using gestures and hand movements.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|つう}じなかった→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{身振|みぶ}り⟦{手振|てぶ}り→手振り：26261_teburi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: Since we didn't share a language, they gave me directions using gestures.

notes:
Very commonly used in the compound phrase {身振|みぶ}り⟦{手振|てぶ}り→手振り：26261_teburi⟧, which emphasizes the use of the whole body and hands together to communicate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身振|みぶ}り⟦{手振|てぶ}り→手振り：26261_teburi⟧ (gestures and hand movements)
- {身振|みぶ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧ (to communicate through gestures)
- {身振|みぶ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|まじ}える (to use gestures along with speech)
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{身振|みぶ}り (exaggerated gestures)

USAGE:
While {身振|みぶ}り can be used alone, the paired form {身振|みぶ}り⟦{手振|てぶ}り→手振り：26261_teburi⟧ is far more common in everyday speech. The compound ⟦ジェスチャー→ジェスチャー：25679_jesuchaa⟧ is also used, especially in casual contexts.
